title: Batching policy rollout and cost-split tracker
summary: Lightweight tracker to coordinate a staged rollout of new batching defaults and a simple cost-split model across teams. Captures per-route expected impact, owners, blockers, and a tentative chargeback percentage for Q2 planning.
notes: Purpose: get consensus on which routes move to new continuous-batching-by-prefix policy in phased windows. Use this sheet to collect final measurements after a 48-hour canary and to decide cost-sharing for Dedicated vs Hosted traffic where autoscaling overlap occurs. Data sources: exports from /analytics/route-usage-2025-02.csv, cost-runner estimates (quantized), and the dedicated capacity forecast spreadsheet. Next steps: Marcus to run batch-sensitivity runs for short-sequence routes; Lina to coordinate customer-impact review w/ solutions engineering; update 'rollout_stage' after canary completes.
